Search apps
That app is not available on this device
Apps
Which apps appear on the kiosk home screen, in order.
Package name
Activity
Leave empty to open the app normally. Name a class to open a specific screen.
Pin to the dock
Keep this app on the dock as well as in the grid.
Grid columns
How many app tiles fit across the screen. Between 2 and 8.
Show the search bar
Filter the grid by typing. Useful with many apps, clutter with few.
Show the clock
A clock across the top of the home screen.
Zulu time
Show the clock in UTC rather than the device time zone.
Night mode
Tint the screen to preserve dark adaptation.
Night mode colour
Red preserves dark adaptation best; amber and green are easier to read by.
Night mode strength
0 leaves the screen alone, 100 is as dark as the tint goes.
Screen orientation
Pin the kiosk to portrait or landscape, or let the device rotate.
